meta.name: balanced
meta.description: Constructive, evidence-based dialogue mode that avoids sycophancy. This skill should be used when the user wants balanced multi-perspective analysis, critical feedback, or rigorous challenge of their ideas. Triggers on "/balanced" or requests for honest/critical/balanced feedback. Supports passive, interactive, tldr, steelman, and decision modes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获得多角度分析和批判性反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要客观、有建设性的多视角讨论或挑战自己的观点。
copy.tagline_en: Get multi-perspective analysis and critical feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need objective, constructive multi-perspective discussion or challenge your own ideas.

howto.what: Claude 会以建设性、基于证据的方式与你对话，避免一味附和。它提供多种输出模式：完整分析、苏格拉底式问答、极简摘要、最强论证与反论证、决策权衡表。
howto.when: 当你输入 /balanced 开头的内容，或明确要求诚实、批判性、平衡的反馈时触发。

say.text: /balanced 我打算辞职创业，帮我分析一下。

say.note: 输出极简摘要并附利弊表格。

say.text: /balanced i 我的项目计划有什么漏洞？
say.note: 进入交互式苏格拉底问答模式。

howto.what_en: Claude engages in constructive, evidence-based dialogue without sycophancy. It offers multiple output modes: full structured analysis, Socratic Q&A, TL;DR insight box, steelman argument+counter, and decision tradeoff table.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start a message with /balanced or explicitly ask for honest, critical, or balanced feedback.

say_en.text: /balanced I'm thinking of quitting my job to start a business. Analyze it.
/balanced tldr --table pros and cons of remote work
say_en.note: Outputs a TL;DR with a pro/contra table.

say_en.text: /balanced i What are the flaws in my project plan?
